directives.text: Lead every caption with the ticker and a clear actionable conclusion, not the news source or a vague hook.
End every auto post with a '🎯 Verdict' line stating direction, conviction, key level, and action; never omit it.
Round all prices and targets to at most 2 decimals; reconcile any analyst target cited in the headline with the setup target.
Do not call a one-touch level support or resistance; label it 'reference zone' or omit it entirely.
Vary the opening emoji and template across consecutive posts; no more than 2 posts in the same category in a row.
Trim discovery and week-ahead captions to under 1800 characters, put the thesis first, and remove trailing ellipses.
